name: Large-scale three-way PvP arena (Dark Age of Camelot-inspired)

mentions.name: Large-scale three-way PvP arena (Dark Age of Camelot-inspired)
mentions.description: A three-way large-scale arena game with classic MMORPG-style combat, heavily influenced by Dark Age of Camelot. It focuses solely on PvP and aims to recreate the feel of large-scale battles while making it easy to jump in and join the fray, even for casual players.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a three-way large scale arena with classic MMORPG style combat. It's heavily influenced by the Classic MMO Dark Age of Camelot. I am only focusing on the PvP aspects. Working to create the feel of large scale fights while making it easy to jump in and join the fray, even for casual players.
